en.headline: Motorcyclist injured after hitting pothole on West Kowloon Highway
en.dek: A 54-year-old rider was taken to Princess Margaret Hospital after his motorcycle overturned near V Walk on Friday afternoon; police are investigating.
body: A 54-year-old motorcyclist was injured and taken to hospital after his motorcycle hit a damaged section of road and overturned on the West Kowloon Highway on Friday afternoon.

According to reports, the man surnamed Lee was riding southbound near the V Walk shopping mall around 1 p.m. when the motorcycle ran over a pothole, lost balance and threw him onto the carriageway. A passing private car driver witnessed the incident and called for help.

Paramedics found the rider conscious with multiple injuries and transported him by ambulance to Princess Margaret Hospital for treatment. Police are investigating the cause of the crash and the condition of the road surface.
Images circulating after the incident showed the overturned motorcycle on the carriageway and officers at the scene. No other vehicles were reported involved.

zh.headline: 西九龍公路電單車轆坑洞翻側 鐵騎士受傷送院
zh.dek: 54歲李姓男子周五下午於V Walk對開路段因路面殘缺人車倒地，清醒送瑪嘉烈醫院，警方調查中。
body: 一名54歲鐵騎士周五下午在西九龍公路因轆過路面坑洞而翻車受傷，送院治理。
據報，姓李男子當時沿公路南行，約下午一時途經V Walk商場對開時，電單車疑因路面殘缺失去平衡，人仰車翻倒地。途經私家車司機目擊後報警。
救護人員到場時傷者仍然清醒，但全身多處受傷，由救護車送往瑪嘉烈醫院接受治療。警方正調查意外原因及路面狀況。
事後網上照片顯示電單車橫亘行車線，警員在場調查。暫未有其他車輛涉及的報告。
